correctness.rationale: Over F2, the LCD Gram determinant of a two-plane spanned by a,b equals Ω(a,b)=a·b+p(a)p(b). The alternating form has radical of dimension epsilon=n mod2. Each nonradical vector has 2^(n-1) partners pairing to 1; dividing ordered symplectic bases by six gives N=(2^n-2^epsilon)2^(n-1)/6. Each of three nonzero vectors in a plane is contained in 2^(n-2)-1 other nondegenerate planes, yielding S1. For disjoint planes a common neighbor is their cross-spanned plane, so two-step iff cross-pairing is nonzero; when pairing vanishes two independent linear functionals furnish a three-step chain and rule out shorter. Orthogonal complement of nondegenerate U contains exactly S3=(2^(n-2)-2^epsilon)2^(n-3)/6 nondegenerate planes, positive for n>=4. Independently reconstructed all plane intersections and BFS distances at n=4,5,6 (20,80,336 vertices), verifying every ordered pair and all sphere counts.
correctness.risk: n>=4, binary, dimension exactly 2, ordinary symmetric neighbor graph.
